paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods on TruthfulQA. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations," utilizing a linear scale with a range from 0 to 2000 and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled "MC1," employing a linear scale with a visible range extending slightly below 37 to above 39, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot contains three distinct lines. The "Linear SAE" method is represented by a dark blue solid line with circular markers. This line starts near an x-value of 25 at a y-value of approximately 37.1, stays flat at x=50, then rises steeply to roughly 37.45 at x=100 and 38.05 at x=250. It climbs more gradually to about 38.2 at x=750 and reaches a local peak of about 38.3 at x=1000. The line then dips to approximately 38.05 at x=1500 before rising sharply to end at its highest y-value of roughly 39.4 at x=2000. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" method is shown as a pink dash-dotted line with no markers, maintaining a steady, constant horizontal trend across the entire x-axis at a y-value of approximately 36.95, accompanied by a corresponding text label just above the right side of the line. The "ICD" method is depicted as a cyan dashed line with no markers, remaining completely steady across the entire x-axis at a y-value of approximately 37.85, accompanied by the text label "ICD (Prompt version)" situated just below the right side of the line.
